nodes.name: CQRS Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node defining Command Query Responsibility Segregation: the analytical read model (snapshots) is separated from the transactional write model (order execution), each independently optimized and eventually/immediately consistent respectively.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology-governed pattern node (PAT-009, structural) with typed frontmatter (pattern_id, realized_by_capabilities) and a required Relationships section for Neo4j export.

nodes.name: Context Assembly Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node describing a budget-aware, intent-aware, admissibility-checked retrieval process that composes prioritized information into a bounded context window for stateless agent invocations.
nodes.languageNotes: Structural pattern node (PAT-006) sourced from wiki memory pages; realized by State Persistence and Context Assembly capabilities.

nodes.name: Evaluation Loop Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node defining a cyclical, metric-driven feedback loop where system output is scored into a scorecard and fed back to governance for promotion or evolution decisions, closing the loop with new architectural decisions.
nodes.languageNotes: Behavioral pattern node (PAT-003); emphasizes quantitative metrics, defined thresholds, and statistical significance over subjective assessment.

nodes.name: Event Sourcing Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node describing immutable, append-only event capture where current state is derived by replaying event history, and the event log serves as both state store and audit trail.
nodes.languageNotes: Behavioral pattern node (PAT-005); realized by Trade Logging and Position Tracking capabilities, foundational to the Pipeline Pattern.

nodes.name: Guardrail Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node defining a boundary validation checkpoint composed of boolean predicates that must ALL pass (conjunction) before an autonomous agent action is permitted; failure is blocking with no partial pass.
nodes.languageNotes: Governance pattern node (PAT-002) with the broadest realization set (Guardrail Enforcement, Promotion Validation, Stop-Loss, Order Management); config externalized to env/policy, not agent memory.

nodes.name: Multi-Agent Coordination Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node describing how specialized stateless agents are organized into functional desks under a single serializing orchestrator, with tracked versions and one-upgrade-at-a-time change management.
nodes.languageNotes: Coordination pattern node (PAT-010); composed into the Supervisor Pattern. No peer-to-peer agent communication — all flows through the orchestrator.

nodes.name: Pipeline Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node defining a linear sequence of single-responsibility processing stages where each stage's output feeds the next, with fail-fast semantics and independent testability (market data to features to snapshots to signals to orders).
nodes.languageNotes: Structural pattern node (PAT-004); the only pattern in this batch realized by a concrete module (Chain Orchestrator). Composed into the Regime Classification Pattern.

nodes.name: Promotion Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node defining a quantitative gate controlling promotion from a safe environment (paper trading) to live production, requiring multi-metric evidence and human approval rather than subjective judgment.
nodes.languageNotes: Governance pattern node (PAT-008); defense-in-depth via a quantitative gate plus mandatory human approval, with no-regression and statistical-significance constraints.

nodes.name: Regime Classification Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node defining a deterministic semantic-abstraction step that interposes a regime label between features and decisions via a priority-ordered, mutually-exclusive rule table (first-match wins) that is a pure function of one feature vector plus versioned config.
nodes.languageNotes: Behavioral pattern node (PAT-011); the only batch pattern with code evidence (src/regime/regime_classifier/taxonomy.py). Composes the Pipeline Pattern; fail-closed on missing input.

nodes.name: Supervisor Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node describing a meta-agent that governs a team of replaceable specialized worker agents under resource constraints, performing evidence-based evaluation, upgrade selection, and deterministic scoring with institutional memory.
nodes.languageNotes: Coordination pattern node (PAT-001); a composite pattern that Composes both the Multi-Agent Coordination Pattern and the Treasury Approval Pattern.

nodes.name: Treasury Approval Pattern.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph pattern node defining a two-gate financial approval process (per-item spendLimit AND available balance) with burn-on-attempt accounting, serialized spends, and an audit trail; budget exhaustion halts activity until replenishment.
nodes.languageNotes: Governance pattern node (PAT-007); composed into the Supervisor Pattern. Models scarcity where failed attempts still deduct from the budget.
